title: Keto Slovakian Kissed Oat Bowl
description: A delicious and unique keto breakfast bowl, combining the flavors of Slovakia with the comforting taste of oats.

ingredients.name: Roasted Slovakian oats
ingredients.notes: Make sure to roast the oats in a pan with a bit of oil until golden brown

ingredients.name: Kissed almond butter
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality almond butter and make sure to mix it well before using

ingredients.name: Slovakian honey
ingredients.notes: Use a pure Slovakian honey and drizzle it on top of the oats

instructions: 1. In a pan, roast the Slovakian oats with a bit of oil until golden brown
2. In a separate bowl, mix together the kissed almond butter and Slovakian honey
3. Add the roasted oats to the bowl and mix well
4. Pour the mixture into a bowl and top with chopped nuts or seeds (optional)
